# Commercial Electrical Contractor in Miami, FL

FSG helps businesses in South Florida and the Miami area get more efficient lighting and electrical systems for their facilities. Our team of South Florida electricians is ready to solve your electrical issues.

[Request a Quote](https://fsg.com/locations/south-florida/#quote)

**Call us at [(786) 298-5534](tel:786-298-5534)**

## Our Commercial Electrical Solutions

![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/2022-07-Comar020-scaled.jpg)

### Lighting Retrofits and Lighting Projects

FSG’s team in South Florida offers turnkey lighting retrofits, lighting products, new construction fixture packages, and comprehensive lighting design services. We are your South Florida lighting contractor.

![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Commercial-Electrical-Contractor-1.jpg)

### Electrical Service, Repair, & Maintenance

From new construction to maintenance, repair, and emergency response services, FSG is an electrical contractor committed to being a partner with our customers! We solve your electrical problems. FSG has the expertise and the relationships to get the job done right.

[![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/iStock-1251125012-2-scaled.jpg)\\
**Electric Vehicle Charging Stations**\\
\\
FSG is uniquely positioned to handle the planning and execution of local and national roll-outs of new EV charging stations. From design to engineering, procurement, installation, and maintenance, FSG is the ideal partner for EV charging station projects in South Florida.](https://fsg.com/ev-charging/)

![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Building-Controls-800x800-1.jpg)

### Building Controls & Smart Buildings

Use lighting controls and smart dashboards to improve the energy efficiency of your commercial building. FSG offers a wide range of lighting controls and smart solutions from a number of manufacturers to help you save more.

![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Shopping-Mall-Signs.jpg)

### Signage

When it comes to your business your sign can be a deal maker or a deal breaker! FSG helps businesses get more out their signage by designing, building, and installing beautiful signage that helps businesses communicate who they are and what they are about!

[![](https://fsg.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Data-Cables-and-server.jpg)\\
**Technology**\\
\\
Structured cabling and A/V are links in the chain that connect your business to your customers. The problem is that these links can be complicated to integrate into the business. FSG is an integrator that helps you use technology to connect your business to your customers.](https://fsg.com/technology/)

## Core Electrical Capabilities & Industries We Serve.

### Commercial Electrical

- [Electrical services](https://fsg.com/electrical/) for commercial facilities

### Commercial Lighting

### Industries We Support Across South Florida

We serve a wide range of industries including education, mission critical, industrial, healthcare, and retail across Davie, Hollywood, Miramar, Pembroke Pines, Cooper City, Weston, Dania Beach, and Fort Lauderdale. Our electricians understand the unique power and safety demands of each facility type — from hospitality, retail, and healthcare facilities across Broward and Miami-Dade counties to data centers, schools, and commercial properties throughout South Florida.

## Commercial Electrical Infrastructure in Miami, FL

Miami and the South Florida region continue to be a major economic hub, with job growth across sectors including construction, trade, and professional services. In the Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach metro area, total nonfarm employment increased by over 42,000 jobs in the past year, with gains in construction among key industries.

Across Miami-Dade and surrounding counties, development activity remains strong as businesses expand offices, mixed-use facilities, and commercial space to meet growing demand. Projects like Miami Worldcenter and dense redevelopment in areas such as Brickell reflect ongoing investment in modern infrastructure that supports businesses and communities alike.

Energy efficiency is an increasing focus for facility upgrades in South Florida, with commercial LED lighting offering significant reductions in energy usage and maintenance costs for property owners.

As Miami’s commercial landscape evolves, FSG Miami delivers expert electrical and lighting solutions designed to support safe, efficient, and future-ready facilities across the region.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently asked questions covering our electrical and lighting capabilities and support across South Florida.

[Still have questions, contact us](https://fsg.com/fsg-contact-us/)

What areas does FSG Miami serve?_Expand_

FSG Miami serves Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Tampa, Miami Beach, Gainesville, Saint Augustine, Bradenton, and throughout South Florida, Miami-Dade County, Broward County, and the entire State of Florida. We provide commercial electrical and lighting services statewide.

What services does FSG Miami provide?_Expand_

FSG Miami provides commercial electrical services, lighting retrofits and projects, electrical service and repair, electric vehicle charging stations, building controls and smart buildings, technology integration, electrical construction, hospitality electrical services, and retail lighting solutions.

Does FSG Miami specialize in hospitality electrical services?_Expand_

Yes, FSG Miami specializes in electrical and lighting services for hotels, resorts, and hospitality facilities. We have completed projects for Marriott Vacation Club and other major hospitality properties throughout South Florida.

Does FSG Miami provide building controls and smart building solutions?_Expand_

Yes, FSG Miami provides lighting controls and smart dashboards to improve energy efficiency of commercial buildings. We offer a wide range of lighting controls and smart solutions from multiple manufacturers to help businesses save more.

Does FSG Miami install EV charging stations?_Expand_

Yes, FSG Miami is uniquely positioned to handle the planning and execution of local and national roll-outs of new EV charging stations. From design to engineering, procurement, installation, and maintenance, FSG is the ideal partner for EV charging station projects in Florida.

What types of projects has FSG Miami completed?_Expand_

FSG Miami has completed projects for Buc-ee's, Coast Dental Services, Cooper's Hawk Winery, Marriott Vacation Club, Montblanc at Dadeland Mall, PetSuites of America, and many other hospitality, retail, healthcare, dining, and commercial facilities throughout Florida.
